frontier.hypothesis: No pure-C construct outside the pre-banned signedness-split family can beat the clean floor 8 at +0x270.
frontier.mechanism: The +0x270 clamp inherently needs a signed compare (slti) AND an unsigned/opaque index value (to prevent the (raw<<16)>>15 -> raw*2 fold that target does NOT do). A single non-cheat value cannot be simultaneously known-signed and unsigned-opaque. Every fold-defeat measured to date (memory dual-read, union, two-pointer, single-u16+cast, and now register-level u16-PHI truncation) is the banned family.
